snippet.title: Trailer - Froggin' Around Demo
snippet.description:
Whishlist now and check out the Froggin' Around Demo on Steam or on itch.io !! 🐸✨ https://store.steampowered.com/app/4005900/Froggin_Around/

Froggin Around is a two player local co-op game where you play as two mischievous frogs on a magical quest! Use your stretchy, bouncy tongues to swing, grab objects, and help each other hop through puzzles and chaotic challenges in this light-hearted, physics-based co-op adventure!

Trailer music created by the amazing Isaac Lavoie

Hope you enjoy our little demo :)
~ Froggin' Around Productions
